profiles.label: iPhone Duo
profiles.validation: Restore and research guest installation are complete. Normal first boot and data migration are in progress; native app behavior remains unverified.
profiles.note: Experimental: a virtual inner iOS display is composited onto one visible cover framebuffer, with software postures. Native layout, touch and runtime behavior remain unverified. The physical hinge and second physical scanout are outside this emulation.

profiles.label: iPhone 16
profiles.validation: No standard iPhone guest has been verified.
profiles.note: The iPhone 16 firmware package has passed its size and SHA-256 checks. Guest startup and native app behavior are not yet verified.
